This is the corpus Kit uses on ITSELF — `node check.js kit --repo .` from the repo root, wired into ci.yml (since kit#119 the C# `kit check kit --repo .`, and the tests named below are C#). _honest: A mapping entry is a HUMAN'S CLAIM that the named test asserts the behaviour. Nothing here checks the test body. That limit is C's and it is not fixable by parsing; it is stated in docs/design/tagging.md and repeated in check.js's output, because a gate quoted second-hand loses its caveats first.
